items.title: Beyond Venture Capital: Why family offices are becoming AI’s most influential investors
items.summary:
Over the past 12 months, I have become increasingly convinced that one of the most underappreciated shifts in the artificial intelligence ecosystem is financial. While much of the market remains focused on OpenAI, Anthropic, Nvidia and the latest model releases, a quieter transformation is taking place in the investor base funding the next generation of […]

items.title: The New Problems AI Is Creating (And How People Are Solving Them)
items.summary: A weekend deep-dive on the second-order problems of the agentic era — AI slop, token economics, de-skilling, the vanishing pipeline of expertise — and the case that companies aren't the bumbling laggards the media paints, but are already solving these problems in public, one shared playbook at a time.

items.title: Revolut’s Nik Storonsky closes a $500m fund for his algorithm-run venture firm QuantumLight
items.summary:
Nik Storonsky, the man behind Revolut, has closed a $500m second fund for QuantumLight, the algorithmic venture-capital firm he co-founded to let software, rather than partners, decide where the money goes. The fund is double the size of QuantumLight’s $250m debut vehicle from last year, a swift escalation for an outfit still trying to prove […]
